51594331.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal Avi-tagged biotinylated human Cbl-b (40 to 426 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) binding assays were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (Cytiva) using N-terminal Avi-tagged biotinylated human Cbl-b (40 to 426 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli and immobilized on a streptavidin-coated sensor chip (SA). The assay was performed in HBS-EP+ buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) at 25 °C. Compounds were diluted in the same buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The association phase lasted 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. The chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software (Cytiva) with a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The reported Kd values are the mean of at least three independent experiments.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. DEL hit (1, a mixture of two diastereomers). Resynthesis and chiral separation led to 2 and 3. See the Supporting Information for ZAP70 biochemical and SPR assay details.
